name: Driven MHD turbulence
blurb: The stirred isothermal box threaded by a guide field B0 along z (out of the plane in 2D, where a weak tangled field in the plane is added for the eddies to wind up): the turbulence is Alfvenic, its eddies stretched along the field, and near the subsonic, strong-field limit compressible MHD approaches the reduced MHD of the taranis WebGPU page of Mallet & Abraham (alfredmallet.github.io/taranis/webgpu/rmhd2d.html), whose driving this follows.
